sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

In continuation of the detailed submissions having made by both the sides for enabling this court to come to fair and correct understanding of facts and circumstances of the case along with the law attending.
Therefore, this case was heard today as well.

The Division Bench of this court, while disposing of LPA No. 101/1994, filed by the predecessor-in-interest of the present petitioners had come to hold that the High Court had the jurisdiction to direct the revenue authorities to decide the matter in terms of the Agrarian Reforms Act, 1976 and accordingly, the Single Bench judgement dated 17.11.1994 passed in OWP no.
1074/1989 declining the indulgence in the matter in favour of the predecessor-in-interest of the petitioners on the premise that the writ court was not to meant to be an executing court with respect to the order passed by the revenue authorities was overturned.
In terms of the Division Bench direction, the needful enquiry and hearing of the matter was to be done within a period of two months.

Since time granted lapsed, as such, a contempt petition No. 01/1998 came to be preferred by the predecessor-in-interest of the petitioners which came to be disposed of in terms of an order dated 09.07.2001.

In this order, the learned Single Bench came to refer to the stand of the respondents in the said contempt petition and they being the Tehsildar and the Divisional Commissioner, citing the fact that order of redemption of mortgage has been implemented by the attestation of mutation No.
2411 but, for the purpose of delivery of possession of the subject land, the requisite still required to be done.

In terms of an order dated 17.08.2003, this court came to direct the Chief Engineer, PWD to file counter affidavit in light of the stand taken by the respondent No. 5, that is the Tehsildar Agrarian Mst. entities.text: Tehsildar Agrarian Mst. Jana And Ors vs State Of J And K
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Reforms Srinagar, Kashmir that PWD has already paid the compensation for land and therefore the petitioners cannot be compensated again for the land in reference.

The respondent No. 6-the Chief Engineer PW(R&B) Department Kashmir came forward with requisite counter affidavit submitted on 19.10.2023 which has nothing factual in it worth taking notice by this court except the fact stated that no record is available with the PW(R&B) Circle Srinagar-South as communicated by the Superintendent Engineer PW(R&B) Circle Srinagar-South.

It is further stated in this counter affidavit that in the PW(R&B) Department, there is no record of acquisition forthcoming with respect to the subject matter land and in fact the entire stretch of land known as Nehru Park is being referred by the Chief Engineer PW(R&B) Department to be in the possession and ownership of the State as per the plea of the Department of Floriculture which is the respondent No. 3 in the writ petition.

Thus, from the end of the Chief Engineer, PW(R&B) Department Srinagar the position reported is blank, leaving this court to exercise its best judgement on the available facts and circumstances and the record obtaining on the file of this writ petition.

Before proceeding to the conclusion of the arguments, this court deems it essential to direct the respondent No. 1-Commissioner/Secretary to the Government, Revenue Department as well as the respondent No. 4-the Deputy Commissioner Srinagar and the respondent No. 5, the Tehsildar Agrarian Reforms, Srinagar to place on record the mutation No. 2411 as referred in the order dated 09.07.2001 passed by this court in contempt petition No. 01/1998.
The respondents are at liberty to produce any other attending record which as per their discretion needs to be brought on record of this file for the purpose of their satisfaction.
Let needful be done by or before the next date of hearing.

(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE SRINAGAR 14.03.2024 Ishaq Mst. Jana And Ors vs State Of J And K Through ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16428996/
